name: Parks Closure Status Due to COVID-19: Dog Runs
description: This dataset tracks the closure and reopening status of dog runs in New York City parks during the COVID-19 pandemic. Each of the 85 sampled rows represents a dog run property, identified by name, property and sub-property names, borough, park district, and GIS property number. The records include a status field along with closure type, approximate dates of closure and reopening, and flags indicating whether red closure signs were installed or yellow signs were removed. An edit date and polygon geometry are also included. The data can be used to monitor how dog run access changed over time during the pandemic, compare closures across boroughs and park districts, map affected locations, and study the timing of closures and reopenings.
